questions.evidence:
PRACTICE PAPER EVENING: This school activity uses an original practice set, not an official examination paper. The reading period runs from 4:00 to 4:25, followed by ten minutes for checking evidence without the answer key. Group discussion begins at 4:35.

Work independently during both initial periods. You may change an answer while checking evidence, but mark the change so you can compare your first reasoning with your later reasoning. The answer key will be handed out only when discussion begins.

Bring a pencil and your reading notes. Notes stay closed during the timed periods and may be opened during discussion. If you arrive late, finish when everyone else finishes; no extra individual time is added. This activity is for finding useful next steps in practice. Its raw score is not an official exam level or a prediction of one.
